<mxfile host="drawio"><diagram id="cache" name="Cache in front of the database"><mxGraphModel dx="760" dy="330" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="760" pageHeight="330" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/><mxCell id="c3" value="" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=24;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D0D7DE;strokeWidth=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="0" y="0" width="760" height="330" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c4" value="App server" style="shape=image;html=0;imageAspect=1;aspect=fixed;image=data:image/png,;fontSize=14;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontColor=#333333;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;labelPosition=center;align=center;spacingTop=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="120" width="80" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c5" value="Cache (in memory)
very fast" style="shape=image;html=0;imageAspect=1;aspect=fixed;image=data:image/png,;fontSize=14;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontColor=#333333;labelPosition=right;verticalLabelPosition=middle;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="470" y="30" width="80" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c6" value="Database (on disk)
slower" style="shape=image;html=0;imageAspect=1;aspect=fixed;image=data:image/png,;fontSize=14;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontColor=#333333;labelPosition=right;verticalLabelPosition=middle;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="470" y="220" width="80" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c7" value="1. ask the cache first" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=7;html=0;rounded=0;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F08A24;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#F08A24;" edge="1" parent="1" source="c4" target="c5"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c8" value="2. not there? ask the database" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=7;html=0;rounded=0;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2E8DA6;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#2E8DA6;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="c4" target="c6"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c9" value="3. keep a copy
for next time" style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=7;html=0;rounded=0;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#666666;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="c6" target="c5"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
